name: session-summary
description: Pane with a very short running summary of what happened in this session, written in cheap batches by the cheapest model (Haiku) from a small digest, only while the pane is open

model.title: Model
model.description: Model that writes the summary: an alias or a model id. The cheapest one is haiku.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language the summary is written in, for example English, German or French. The button in the pane switches it and its choice wins.

auto.title: Update after every turn
auto.description: Off: the summary only updates when you press the button in the pane. Every update costs a small Haiku call.
